brief: Today's news covers a major Indonesian earthquake, renewed Middle East tensions, a U.S. political comeback bid, and lighter stories from viral sea lion assault to world's ugliest dog. Research highlights AI trust in oncology, cybersecurity/innovation balance, and neural mechanisms of emotion regulation.
news_summary: A 7.7-magnitude earthquake in eastern Indonesia has killed at least 47 people, while Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon have killed 11, marking the worst toll since a June truce. In U.S. politics, Sherrod Brown seeks a Senate comeback in Ohio, and other items include a school shooting, a stranded family, and a posthumous award for an Indigenous culture promoter.
papers_summary: Recent papers explore balancing innovation and cybersecurity in regulated organizations, trust in AI for oncology decision support, and the role of zDHHC palmitoyltransferases in neuronal differentiation. Additional studies investigate emotion regulation pathways and sustainable zeolite synthesis.

zh.brief: 今日焦点为韩国股市暴跌重创散户，以及台湾前总统陈水扁女儿离婚事件引发的媒体伦理反思。国际方面，印尼强震伤亡持续攀升，黎巴嫩遭以色列空袭。
